definitions: A female given name from French.

Numerous places:
A civil parish of Queens County, Prince Edward Island, Canada. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
 A parish of Saint Vincent, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines; in full, Charlotte Parish. Capital: Georgetown.
A number of places in the United States, including:
A city, the county seat of Eaton County, Michigan.
A city, the county seat of Mecklenburg County, North Carolina. 

A town, the county seat of Dickson County, Tennessee.
A town in Chittenden County, Vermont, named after Queen Charlotte.
A type of women's bonnet popular in the 18th and 19th centuries.

blocks.text: Charlotte is a feminine given name. It is a female form of the male name Charles. It is of French or Italian origin, meaning "free man" or "petite". It dates back to at least the 14th century.
